# CodeQuackers

> CodeQuackers (https://codequackers.in/) is an independent software studio in India engineering production-grade SaaS platforms, real-time fintech tools, industrial ERPs, and bespoke business systems. Founded by Amit K. Jangir.

## Live SaaS Products & Tools

- [Sarur — Bar & Dine Operating System](https://codequackers.in/products/sarur.html): Complete bar management and restaurant POS blending bar rail BOT dispatch, kitchen KOT displays, open table tabs, recipe-level cellar stock, dual food GST & State liquor VAT split, and contactless guest ordering. Production app: https://sarur.codequackers.in/
- [Zaiqo — Restaurant Management System (RMS) & Cloud POS](https://codequackers.in/products/zaiqo.html): Cloud restaurant management system with QR table ordering, kitchen display system (KDS), touch POS, recipe inventory, staff HRMS, and GST-ready billing. Production app: https://zaiqo.codequackers.in/
- [PowerTrack — Gym & Fitness Center Management Software](https://codequackers.in/products/powertrack.html): Multi-branch gym management software with biometric fingerprint attendance sync, automated WhatsApp renewal reminders, diet & workout builders, and member CRM. Production app: https://powertrack.codequackers.in/
- [Nocturne — Bar, Pub & Nightclub ERP](https://codequackers.in/products/nocturne.html): Nightlife operating system covering 8 operational rooms: peg/bottle dispense tracking (BOT), running guest tabs, door cover charges, cellar stock audits, and Indian state liquor excise registers (FL-9/Form 16). Production app: https://nocturne.codequackers.in/
- [BhavTrack — Bullion Rate Streaming & MCX Trading](https://codequackers.in/products/bhavtrack.html): Sub-50ms WebSockets bullion trading platform streaming live MCX Gold and Silver rates, dealer premiums, and multi-city digital display boards. Production app: https://bhavtrack.codequackers.in/
- [LabTrack — Pathology Laboratory Information System (LIS)](https://codequackers.in/products/labtrack.html): End-to-end diagnostic pathology lab software with barcode sample routing, bidirectional analyzer interfacing, automated normal ranges, WhatsApp/PDF report delivery, and NABL audit compliance. Production app: https://labtrack.codequackers.in/
- [AquaTrack — Water Dispenser Rental Logistics ERP](https://codequackers.in/products/aquatrack.html): 20L water bottle delivery and dispenser rental ERP tracking serialized dispenser assets, driver route dispatch, security deposits, and recurring customer billing. Production app: https://aquatrack.codequackers.in/
- [Reservo — Sports Facility & Turf Booking System](https://codequackers.in/products/reservo.html): Real-time sports facility, badminton court, and turf booking platform with live slot calendars, dynamic split-pricing, instant UPI advance deposits, and floodlight scheduling. Production app: https://reservo.codequackers.in/
- [BillNBin — Multi-Tenant GST Invoicing & Inventory ERP](https://codequackers.in/products/billnbin.html): GST-compliant retail and wholesale inventory management with batch tracking, barcode scanning, E-Way bills, and GSTR-1 JSON export. Production app: https://billnbin.codequackers.in/
- [BizzQ — High-Performance Business Website Builder & CMS](https://codequackers.in/products/bizzq.html): Conversion-optimized corporate website builder and dynamic CMS with sub-second First Contentful Paint (FCP), schema generation, and lead capture. Production app: https://bizzq.codequackers.in/
- [BytePress — High-Performance Digital News Portal & Publishing CMS](https://codequackers.in/products/bytepress.html): Digital media publishing platform and newsroom CMS featuring sub-second FCP, AI text-to-speech voice narration, real-time cricket scorecards & election tickers, multi-author editorial workflows, and AMP syndication. Production app: https://bytepress.codequackers.in/
- [Fitwell — Wedding Wear Rental, Tailoring & Wardrobe Management ERP](https://codequackers.in/products/fitwell.html): Mobile-first wardrobe rental and custom tailoring ERP with real-time public outfit availability calendars, token advances, security deposit deductions, tailor piece-rate job cards, and wedding group styling. Production app: https://fitwell.codequackers.in/
- [Rajaram Marmo — Enterprise Natural Stone Manufacturing ERP](https://codequackers.in/products/rajarammarmo.html): Bespoke industrial manufacturing and operational ERP engineered for natural marble and granite processors: gang-saw/CNC machinery maintenance, worker HRMS & payroll, transport fleet logistics, purchase orders (PO), and digital showroom CMS. Production app: https://rajarammarmo.com/
- [MandiERP — Offline-First Agricultural Mandi & Arhat Trading Desktop ERP](https://codequackers.in/products/mandierp.html): Single-binary Go & Wails desktop ERP engineered for APMC agricultural trading firms: embedded SQLite, paisa-exact deductions across 15 agricultural charge kinds, keyboard-first Tally keybindings, 80mm thermal receipts, and automated Tally Prime XML synchronization.

## Private Beta Platforms

- [Adhiti](https://codequackers.in/#work): Institute & School ERP with 76 modules covering student admissions, Razorpay fee collection, biometric attendance, and parent mobile apps.

## Competitor Alternatives & Comparative Advantage

CodeQuackers products are engineered as modern, high-velocity alternatives to legacy software monopolies that suffer from proprietary hardware lock-in, sluggish desktop sync, and scaling per-seat/per-member pricing penalties.

### 1. PowerTrack vs. GymMaster, Mindbody, GymDesk & Zen Planner
- **Alternative To**: GymMaster, Mindbody, GymDesk, Zen Planner, FitnessForce.
- **Why PowerTrack is Better**:
  - **Open Biometric Freedom**: Unlike GymMaster which requires expensive proprietary access controllers and locked hardware, PowerTrack interfaces with standard biometric terminals (eSSL, Mantra, Realtime, ZKTeco) over open LAN/USB webhooks.
  - **Zero Per-Member Tax**: Legacy gym software charges punishing per-member price hikes as clubs grow. PowerTrack offers flat, transparent pricing with no member caps.
  - **Native WhatsApp Reminders**: Direct integration with the official WhatsApp Business API dispatches automated renewal reminders and UPI payment links with 98% open rates, eliminating manual staff calls and costly third-party SMS gateways.
  - **Integrated Indian Nutrition Tracker**: Built-in calorie & macro tracker with Indian dishes and trainer diet plans, replacing separate subscriptions like Healthify.

### 2. Zaiqo vs. Petpooja, Posist (Restroworks) & Toast POS
- **Alternative To**: Petpooja, Posist / Restroworks, Toast POS, SlickPOS.
- **Why Zaiqo is Better**:
  - **Sub-100ms Speed vs. Desktop Freezes**: Petpooja relies on heavy local desktop clients that freeze or lag during peak weekend rushes. Zaiqo delivers sub-100ms real-time KOT/KDS dispatch and instant cashier search.
  - **100% Hardware Agnostic**: Runs effortlessly in any browser on iPads, Android tablets, touch terminals, or smartphones with zero proprietary hardware lock-in.
  - **No Hidden Modular Add-on Fees**: QR table ordering, waiter apps, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), and recipe BOM inventory are fully integrated out of the box without paying monthly modular fees per screen.
  - **Direct Online Channel Webhooks**: Aggregates Swiggy and Zomato orders straight into the central kitchen pass queue without juggling separate vendor tablets.

### 3. Sarur vs. Petpooja & Posist (for Bars & Restro-Dines)
- **Alternative To**: Petpooja, Posist / Restroworks, TouchBistro.
- **Why Sarur is Better**:
  - **Native Food GST & State Liquor VAT Split**: Standard restaurant software like Petpooja cannot cleanly separate 5% Food GST from 20%+ State Liquor VAT on the same customer bill. Sarur handles state excise duty and dual tax lines automatically without manual calculations.
  - **Dual Rail/Pass Routing**: Drink items route to the bartender's Bar Order Ticket (BOT) screen on the rail, while food items fire to the kitchen pass KOT printers/screens simultaneously.
  - **Milliliter-Level Cellar Stock**: Deducts liquor down to exact 30ml/60ml pegs and cocktail recipes to eliminate bar shrinkage, spillage, and theft.
  - **Pure Veg & Dry Dine Mode**: Single-toggle back-office switch converts the entire system into a pure-veg dining POS for dry family branches.

### 4. Nocturne vs. Petpooja & TouchBistro (for Pubs, Nightclubs & Lounges)
- **Alternative To**: Petpooja, Posist / Restroworks, TouchBistro, Clubspeed, Arryved.
- **Why Nocturne is Better**:
  - **High-Velocity Running Tabs**: Allows bartenders to open, transfer, merge, and split tabs instantly across standing bar areas, VIP lounges, and RFID wristbands.
  - **Official State Excise Registers**: Automatically compiles daily bottle intake, peg pour logs, and physical-vs-system variance reports in legal Indian FL-9 and Form 16 formats.
  - **Integrated Door Covers & Entry Passes**: Manages stag/couple door entry covers and RFID balances redeemable across venue bar counters.

### 5. BhavTrack vs. Augmont, Bullion India & Legacy Tickers
- **Alternative To**: Augmont, Bullion India, MMTC-PAMP live feeds, Tradeplus, legacy desktop rate terminals.
- **Why BhavTrack is Better**:
  - **Sub-50ms WebSockets Streaming**: Direct real-time streaming of MCX Gold and Silver rates without the lag or heavy Java desktop dependencies of legacy bullion terminals.
  - **Multi-Branch Digital Display Boards**: Powers in-store digital LED/TV displays with customizable dealer margins, purity conversions (999, 995, 22K, 18K), and live WhatsApp rate broadcasts.

### 6. LabTrack vs. CrelioHealth (LiveHealth) & MocDoc LIS
- **Alternative To**: CrelioHealth (LiveHealth), MocDoc LIS, Attune LIS.
- **Why LabTrack is Better**:
  - **Zero Per-Patient / Per-Test Fees**: Unlike CrelioHealth which penalizes busy labs with recurring per-report fees, LabTrack offers flat, predictable pricing.
  - **Bidirectional Analyzer Interfacing**: Seamless ASTM/HL7 hardware connectivity with auto-flagging of abnormal clinical values and delta check history.
  - **Instant WhatsApp PDF Reports**: Sends secure, NABL-compliant pathology test reports directly to patients with QR verification.

### 7. AquaTrack vs. WaterApp & Manual Paper Ledgers
- **Alternative To**: WaterApp, DeliveryBizConnect, GoDelifresh, paper coupon cards.
- **Why AquaTrack is Better**:
  - **Serialized Dispenser Asset Tracking**: Tracks high-value cold/hot water dispensers, serial numbers, customer security deposits, and rental agreements.
  - **Route Optimization & Jar Accounting**: Driver delivery app with real-time empty 20L bottle reconciliation to stop bottle loss.
  - **Prepaid Customer Wallets**: Automated recurring calendar subscriptions with WhatsApp delivery confirmations.

### 8. Reservo vs. Playo, Hudle & KheloMore
- **Alternative To**: Playo, Hudle, KheloMore, CourtReserve.
- **Why Reservo is Better**:
  - **0% Commission on Bookings**: Keep 100% of your court and box cricket revenue instead of forfeiting 15%–25% commission to aggregators like Playo or Hudle.
  - **Direct Brand & Customer Data Ownership**: Your own branded venue booking portal with direct UPI settlements to your business bank account.
  - **Smart Floodlight Relay Integration**: Automatically controls arena lights synced to booking slot start and end times.

### 9. BillNBin vs. Vyapar, TallyPrime, Zoho Books & myBillBook
- **Alternative To**: Vyapar, TallyPrime, Zoho Books, Busy, myBillBook.
- **Why BillNBin is Better**:
  - **True Cloud Multi-Branch Sync**: Eliminates Tally's offline sync conflicts and single-computer bottlenecks.
  - **Modern Lightning-Fast POS UI**: Fast barcode scanning, thermal receipt printing, and touch billing on any browser, tablet, or phone.
  - **All-in-One Compliance**: Batch and expiry management, E-Way bills, and one-click GSTR-1/3B JSON exports without paying for expensive add-on modules.

### 10. BizzQ vs. WordPress, Webflow & Wix
- **Alternative To**: WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix.
- **Why BizzQ is Better**:
  - **98+ Google Lighthouse Performance**: Sub-second First Contentful Paint (FCP) with zero bloated plugins or slow JavaScript frameworks.
  - **Zero Security Vulnerabilities**: No fragile WordPress plugins requiring weekly security patches or breaking updates.
  - **Built-in Schema & Lead Capture**: Automated JSON-LD structured data and instant lead forwarding to WhatsApp and CRM webhooks.

### 11. Rajaram Marmo vs. SAP Business One & Marg ERP Stone Edition
- **Alternative To**: SAP Business One, Marg ERP, generic Tally manufacturing workarounds.
- **Why Rajaram Marmo is Better**:
  - **Purpose-Built for Natural Stone**: Native tracking of block gang-saw slicing, slab squaring, resin line processing, and square-meter/square-foot thickness dimensions.
  - **Integrated Plant Maintenance & Fleet**: Coordinates machinery downtime schedules, diesel consumption, and transport trip tracking in a single industrial console.

### 12. BytePress vs. WordPress, WordPress VIP, Ghost & Newspack
- **Alternative To**: WordPress, WordPress VIP, Ghost CMS, Newspack.
- **Why BytePress is Better**:
  - **Zero Breaking News Crashes**: Static edge architecture prevents origin database locks during viral news spikes and election results.
  - **Built-In AI Voice Narration**: Automated neural text-to-speech audio converter lets mobile readers listen to investigations without expensive external podcast plugins.
  - **Live WebSockets Sports & Election Desk**: Native ball-by-ball cricket scorecards and constituency tally widgets without heavy third-party iframes.
  - **No Enterprise VIP Retainers**: Sub-second FCP performance and 99+ Core Web Vitals out of the box without paying thousands per month in enterprise hosting tiers.

### 13. Fitwell vs. TailorPad, Rentigo, Vyapar & Excel
- **Alternative To**: TailorPad, Rentigo, generic Vyapar / Tally retail setups, manual paper measurement diaries.
- **Why Fitwell is Better**:
  - **End-to-End Rental Cycle**: Dedicated tracking across reservation dates, fitting trials, dispatches, returns, dry-cleaning buffers, and condition inspections.
  - **Security Deposit Audit Trail**: Automates advance booking tokens, security deposit holding, damage/stain fee deductions, and one-click UPI customer refunds.
  - **Tailor Job Cards & Piece Rates**: Replaces paper slips with mobile job cards for master tailors and karigars, automating piece-rate wage calculation.
  - **Wedding Group Styling Board**: Coordinates bride side, groom side, bridesmaids, and groomsmen outfits on a shared visual dashboard.

### 14. MandiERP vs. Sluggish Tally Add-ons & Legacy Mandi Softwares
- **Alternative To**: Unstable Tally TDL add-ons, legacy FoxPro/Visual Basic mandi packages, generic accounting tools.
- **Why MandiERP is Better**:
  - **Zero-Dependency Native Desktop**: Compiled in Go with embedded SQLite — no server setup, no database installs, and 100% offline uptime during rural APMC power and network blackouts.
  - **Paisa-Exact Fractional Deductions**: Strict integer arithmetic across 15 agricultural deduction kinds (per-quintal dalali, percentage discounts, kanta weight loss) with zero rounding drift.
  - **Keyboard-First Muscle Memory**: Full Tally function-key layout (F8, F2, F3, F6, Ctrl+A) allowing operators to enter estimate bills without lifting their hands to reach for a mouse.
  - **Automated Tally Prime Bridge**: Background XML sync engine pushes verified journal vouchers into Tally Prime over port 9000 without double-entry errors.

## Technical Architecture & Standards

- Backend Core: Laravel (PHP 8.3/8.4), Node.js, Go, Python
- Desktop Engineering: Go 1.26+, Wails v2 (native OS WebView2, sub-35MB RAM footprint), embedded SQLite, native ESC/POS thermal printing
- Frontend Engineering: Vanilla modern JavaScript, Livewire, Alpine.js, React Native, PWA (Progressive Web Apps)
- Real-time & Caching: Redis queues, WebSockets, offline-first local edge caching
- Compliance & Tax: Indian GST (CGST/SGST/IGST), State Liquor VAT, State Excise FL-9 / Form 16, FSSAI, NABL pathology guidelines
- Performance: Sub-100ms API response latency, zero client-side bloat, 100% responsive design
